text:
infra-bot: [ALERT] apac-1 pool: thermal events spike; 35 host-level GPU errors in 5m, degraded capacity reported.

olivia: seeing sustained model evictions and OOMs on apac-1. queue depth up, KV-cache hit rate dropping. proposing traffic shift to eu/na immediately.

ops-oncall: roger. prefer gradual weights, not full cutover. suggest initial weights apac=15, eu=60, na=25 and monitor p95/p99 and error-rate.

saya: should we preserve session affinity for premium customers? cache warming across regions will be painful if we blast traffic.

marco: +1 to affinity. also recommend routing by model size: route small/quantized models to eu, large unquantized to na to balance GPU memory profiles. keep ~10% apac for sticky premium sessions.

rex: note — cross-region egress for embeddings-heavy tenants will spike billing. if we shift large embedding workloads out of apac, estimate +30-50% egress on those customers. flag finance.

olivia: good call. we'll apply weighted policy + model-variant hints. applying change via glbctl now.

saya: ```
# glbctl patch-route --route infer.global --policy weighted \
#   --weights apac=12,eu=64,na=24 \
#   --session-affinity "customer_id:ttl=300s" 
```

infra-bot: deploy-bot: routing policy change submitted by olivia, id=chg-20260318-01, queued for execution.

ops-oncall: change applied. current effective weights: apac=12, eu=64, na=24. watching metrics. p50/p95/p99 streams on Grafana: link https://grafana.internal/d/inf -- keep an eye on kv_hit_rate and tail error-rate.

anya: creating a canary evaluator to detect hallucination/regression for chat models (short window) — will trigger if generated length or token drop > 10% vs baseline.

marco: quick checks you can run after change: ```
# curl -s https://edge-metrics.internal/api/kv_hits?region=eu | jq .hit_rate
# kubectl -n serving logs -l app=infer-router --tail=200 | grep "route=eu" | tail -n 20
```

infra-bot: metrics update (5m): apac inference p95=260ms -> eu p95=310ms after shift; overall error-rate +0.3pp transient, now trending down. KV hit-rate in eu currently 18% (cold).

olivia: traffic shift in place, evictions on apac dropping. keeping the shift for 2 hours to let cache warm and confirm stability. created jira INFRA-412 for follow-up and capacity plan.

rex: please add a cost-impact estimate to INFRA-412 — need a delta for cross-region egress and extra EU/NA GPU minutes if this persists.

ops-oncall: scheduling a capacity spike test for apac tomorrow morning; prefer scaling the apac pool rather than prolonged cross-region routing. will coordinate with capacity team.

olivia: thanks everyone — closing this thread. I'll post the timeline and metrics snapshot to #postmortems and attach INFRA-412. If anything regresses, re-open or ping @ops-oncall. :white_check_mark:
